title: [Extensibility Request][Subscription Billing] Extension points for a partner billing extension: Billing Proposal visibility, purchase-side event parity, usage-based billing period, document line creation
summary: Subscription Billing adds extension points including public methods, purchase-side events for parity with sales, usage-based billing events, and document line creation events to enable partner extensions without maintaining private code copies.
key_points: Makes four Billing Proposal procedures public so partners can call them instead of keeping private copies
Adds an event after the usage-based subscription billing period is calculated
Adds purchase-side events for contract description lines and purchase header creation, matching the sales side
Adds IsHandled events before sales and purchase line creation from billing lines
Makes Usage Data Billing SaveDocumentValues public so handlers can keep usage billing links consistent
